summary: The catch-up projection deferral clears once its pass covers every admitted replication claim, so local inline-projected writes no longer keep it set

replay.detail: No graph replay. The projection pass and its frontier commits are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change. The clear now compares the pass frontier with the existing replication_admitted_index metadata, read under the writer exclusion next to the generation snapshot.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The generation compare-and-swap that guards the clear is kept.

compatibility.detail: Readiness changes on every daemon. Before, the deferral cleared only when the pass reached the store index, and local inline-projected writes advance that index, so a daemon taking local writes during catch-up could stay deferred and keep re-running settle passes after all received claims were projected. Now the deferral clears when the pass reaches the last admitted replication claim, and catch-up reports ready earlier under local write load. No wire, stored format or claim kind change.

downtime.detail: None; takes effect on process restart.

recovery.detail: Nothing stored changes. Reverting restores the old deferral clear against the store index, including its extra settle passes under local writes.
